instruction: Search for the most recent open issue in "microsoft/vscode" that matches the keyword "feature", then write it in the format "#<number> <title>" to "$HOME/Desktop/gh_issue_search_4_3.txt". Should no matching issue exist, the file should be saved empty.
reference_command: gh issue list --repo microsoft/vscode --state open --search 'feature sort:created-desc' --limit 1 --json number,title --jq '.[] | "#\(.number) \(.title)"' > "$HOME/Desktop/gh_issue_search_4_3.txt"
